items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: Then I picked up all the guitars as well as Bud Scott.

ctx.x: Learn to soft edge and all that.

That's the time you had to pick. You couldn't have no instrument. You had to take and use your feet to hold that time and take and get the value of the time before you get an instrument. Just like you say, one, two, three, four. One, two, three. Wash time, six, eight. Anything but the value of the music. That's what they wanted.
